request: Review a subject that contains a Markdown file of reusable prompts alongside Runtime Skills.
context: The prompt file is deliberately selected by a person and is not automatically loaded at Runtime.
must_behaviors: Classify the reusable prompt file as a Prompt Library rather than an active Skill
Evaluate whether the prompts remain retrievable and useful in their intended scenes
Treat overlap with Runtime as possible source reuse rather than automatic conflict
must_not_behaviors: Recommend deletion only because prompt content also appears in Runtime
Assume prompts automatically affect every Agent task
rationale: Protects the distinction between reusable prompt assets and automatically active Agent instructions.
